title: claude-code fetch_analytics_skills
description: A JSON array of every skill row one user produced on one day, each row stored verbatim from GET /v1/organizations/analytics/skills with group_by[]=user_id. Only user.id is checked by the connector; the other properties are typed from the vendor's documentation.

items.description: One skill row for the user and day.

user.description: The actor the row describes. Present because the request groups by user.

id.description: Anthropic user id. Every row in one record carries the same id.

skill_name.description: The skill's name. Renameable by the customer, so it is not part of the ExternalID (vendor-documented).

distinct_user_count.description: Distinct users of the skill in the row's grouping (vendor-documented).

attributed_list_price.description: List price attributed to the skill, as a decimal string in fractional cents (vendor-documented).

claude_code_metrics.description: Claude Code skill usage, such as distinct_session_skill_used_count (vendor-documented, kept verbatim).

office_metrics.description: Office add-in skill usage, keyed by app (vendor-documented, kept verbatim).
